html:
The Indonesian National Revolution was the war of independence fought from 1945 to 1949 between the new Republic of Indonesia and the Netherlands, after independence was declared on 17 August 1945.

British troops landed first and fought a bloody battle at Surabaya in November 1945. The Dutch then launched two large offensives and captured the republic's capital, Yogyakarta, and its leaders, Sukarno among them, in 1948.

Guerrilla resistance and pressure from the United States and the United Nations forced the Dutch to transfer sovereignty on 27 December 1949. Many thousands died. The Dutch kept western New Guinea until 1962; see Act of Free Choice.
sum: The Indonesian National Revolution was the war of independence fought from 1945 to 1949 between the new Republic of Indonesia and the Netherlands, after independence was declared on 17 August 1945.
